Consistent orthographic isometric view from above at 35 degrees, sunlight upper left, soft contact shadows, tactile matte clay and painted wood, rounded beveled buildings, exquisitely crafted like a high-end miniature diorama. Entire composition is a connected small town, with winding warm gray roads with ivory lane markings, pedestrian crossings, green verges. Charming tiny unbranded sports cars, quiet foliage. The road connects every destination. No people, no faces, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO TEXT OR LOGOS, NO USER INTERFACE, NO LABELS. Leave space near buildings for HTML labels. Frame full town completely with margins on all edges. This is an actual environment art asset, not a webpage mockup.
